'''Isnti''', officially the '''Federal Republic of Isnti''', is a country in [[South Mahea]]. It is bordered by [[Pelugrotoa]] to the north, [[Byllu]] to the west, and [[Ocaun]] and [[Galca]] to the east, and has a coastline along the [[Adrad Sea]] in the east. It spans an area of about {{Convert|250,357|km2|sqmi|lk=out|abbr=on}}. Isnti has a population of about 35 million people, the majority of whom are ethnically [[Isnti people|Isnti]]. Its capital and [[List of cities and towns in Isnti|most populous city]] is [[Mahsira]], followed by [[Sahmado]] and [[Amhurok]].

In the early 5th century, the [[Hepdan peoples]] migrated from the [[Amoray]] to the [[Galcan Peninsula]], becoming the Hepdan Empire in 624 when it conquered the [[Kingdom of Kuhn]]. In 802 AFA, the Kingdom of [[Smasdan Zaridai]] was founded within the warring Hepdan princes of Lasdan. This marked the beginning of the [[Zaridai Era|Zaridai]] Era for Isnti. The [[Thessovini-controlled kingdom]] facilitated the spread of the [[Thessovini]], replacing [[Passanu]] in the region, and undertook religious infrastructural projects throughout the region. In the late 14th century, it was split between Ocaun and Farones. It gained independence in 1525 AFA as the [[Isnti Kingdom]], and acted as a buffer state between [[Ocaun]] and [[Pelugrotoa]]. Isnti became an [[Emaran Protectorate of Isnti|Emara Colony]] in 1631 after the king signed the [[Treaty of Lindarbah]]. Following [[Ashani occupation of Isnti|Ashani occupation]] during the [[Red War]], Isnti declared independence from Emara in 1692, Gaining property independence in 1708, establishing a new constitution.

Isnti is a [[wikipedia:Parliamentary republic|Federal parliamentary republic]] and a [[multi-party system|multi-party]] state. The GTU designates Isnti a [[wikipedia:least developed country|least developed country]]. [[wikipedia:Agriculture|Agriculture]] remains its dominant economic sector, with growth in textiles, construction, garments, and [[wikipedia:tourism|tourism]] leading to increased foreign investment and international trade. [[wikipedia:Corruption|Corruption]], [[Deforestation in Isnti|deforestation]], [[Human rights in Isnti|human rights issues]] and [[Scam centres in Isnti|organized crime]] have remained major challenges in Isnti's post-conflict development. The official and most widely spoken language is [[Isnti language|Isnti]], and the most widely practiced religion is [[Thessovini in Isnti|Thessovini]].
